G617076.description: Edineț (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈedinet͡s]) is a municipality in northern Moldova. It is the administrative center of the eponymous district.

G617164.description: Vadul lui Vodă (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈvadul luj ˈvodə]) is a town in Chișinău municipality, Moldova, situated about 23 km east of the capital on the right (western) bank of the Dniester River. It is the country’s largest spa, recreation, and leisure resort.

G617180.description: Ungheni (Romanian pronunciation: [uŋˈɡenʲ] ) is a city, municipality and the seat of Ungheni District in the Republic of Moldova. There is a bridge across the Prut River and a border checkpoint to Romania.

G617239.description: Tiraspol is the capital and largest city of Transnistria, a breakaway state of Moldova, where it is the second-largest city. The city is located on the eastern bank of the Dniester River.

G617254.description: Telenești (Romanian pronunciation: [teleˈneʃtʲ]) is a city in Moldova, located 91 kilometres to the north of the capital city, Chișinău. Telenești is the administrative center of the eponymous district.

G617270.description: Taraclia (Romanian pronunciation: [taraˈkli.a]; Bulgarian: Тараклия) is a city located in southern Moldova. It is the capital of Taraclia District and the center of Bulgarians in Moldova.

G617284.description: Ștefan Vodă (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈʃtefan ˈvodə] ) is a city and the administrative centre of Ștefan Vodă District, Moldova.

G617372.description: Șoldănești (Romanian pronunciation: [ʃoldəˈneʃtʲ]) is a city in Moldova. It is the capital of Șoldănești District.

G617482.description: Rîșcani (Romanian pronunciation: [rɨʃˈkanʲ], also spelled Râșcani) is a city in Moldova. It is located in the north-western part of the country, in the old Bessarabia region.

G617486.description: Rîbnița (Romanian: Rîbnița, Râbnița, Rîmnița or Râmnița, Moldovan Cyrillic: Рыбница, pronounced [ˈrɨbnitsa]) or Rybnitsa is a town in the breakaway Moldovan region of Transnistria. According to the 2004 census, it has a population of 53,648.

G617638.description: Orhei (Romanian pronunciation: [orˈhej]) is a city, municipality and the administrative centre of Orhei District in the Republic of Moldova, with a population of 22,183. It lies roughly 40 kilometres (25 miles) north of the capital, Chișinău.

G617659.description: Ocnița (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈoknitsa]) is a town and the administrative center of Ocnița District in northern Moldova.

G617702.description: Anenii Noi (Romanian pronunciation: [aˈnenij ˈnoj]) is a city in east-central Moldova, the seat of Anenii Noi District. It is located 36 km (22 mi) SE of the capital, Chișinău.

G617914.description: Sîngerei [sɨndʒerej] (also spelled Sângerei) is a city in Moldova. It is located in the north-central part of the country.

G617993.description: Hîncești (Romanian pronunciation: [hɨnˈt͡ʃeʃtʲ]) is a city and municipality in Moldova. Hîncești is situated on the Cogâlnic River, 33 km (21 mi) southwest of the Moldovan capital, Chișinău.

G618120.description: Căușeni (Romanian pronunciation: [kə.uˈʃenʲ]) is a city in the Republic of Moldova and the administrative center of Căușeni District.

G618196.description: Ialoveni (Romanian pronunciation: [jaloˈvenʲ]) is a city in the Republic of Moldova situated 10 km (6 mi) from Chișinău. The city is administrative center of the Ialoveni District.

G618329.description: Florești (Romanian pronunciation: [floˈreʃtʲ]) is the capital city and industrial and commercial center of Floreşti District of Moldova. It is located on the river Răut.

G618365.description: Dubăsari (Romanian pronunciation: [dubəˈsarʲ]; Moldovan Cyrillic: Дубэсарь) or Dubossary (Russian: Дубоссары; Yiddish: דובאסאר; Ukrainian: Дубоcсари) is a city in Transnistria, with a population of 23,650. Claimed by both the Republic of Moldova and the Transnistrian Moldavian Republic, the city is under the latter's administration, and functions as the seat of the Dubăsari District.

G618382.description: Dondușeni (Romanian pronunciation: [donduˈʃenʲ]) is a city in Moldova. It is located in the north-eastern part of the country.

G618403.description: Criuleni (Romanian pronunciation: [kri.uˈlenʲ]) is a city in Moldova. It is located in the north-eastern part of the country.

G618405.description: Comrat (Romanian: Comrat, Romanian pronunciation: [komˈrat]; Gagauz: Komrat, Russian: Комрат) is a city and municipality in Moldova and the capital city of the autonomous region of Gagauzia. It is located in the south of the country, on the Ialpug River.

G618426.description: Chișinău ( KIH-shih-NOW; Romanian: [kiʃiˈnəw] ; formerly known by its Russian form Kishinev) is the capital and largest city of Moldova by area and population. The city is Moldova's main industrial and commercial centre.

G618454.description: Călărași (Romanian pronunciation: [kələˈraʃʲ] ) is a town in Moldova, founded in 1848. Long ago, the word "călărași" meant "horsemen" (today the word is "călăreți").

G618456.description: Cahul (Romanian: [kaˈhul]; also known by alternative names) is a city and municipality in southern Moldova. The city is the administrative center of Cahul District; it also administers one village, Cotihana.

G618510.description: Briceni (Romanian pronunciation: [briˈt͡ʃenʲ]) is a city in northern Moldova. It is the seat of Briceni District.

G618577.description: Bender ([benˈder], Moldovan Cyrillic: Бендер) or Bendery (Russian: Бендеры, [bʲɪnˈdɛrɨ]; Ukrainian: Бендери), also known as Tighina, is a city within the internationally recognized borders of Moldova under de facto control of the unrecognized Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic (Transnistria) (PMR) since 1992. It is located on the western bank of the river Dniester in the historical region of Bessarabia.

G618594.description: Basarabeasca (Romanian pronunciation: [basaraˈbe̯aska]) is a city in Moldova. It is the capital of Basarabeasca District.
